subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR define the canonical public session activity contract now, or should the Gateway RPC/event/plugin hooks wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to be decided?
rationale: The change creates Gateway protocol and plugin SDK contracts, while the canonical activity/attention issue is still open and current main already has narrower task and tool activity surfaces.

options.title: Align And Repair This PR
options.body: Use this PR as the implementation vehicle only after it matches the canonical activity semantics, fixes selected-global scoping, and rebases onto the current UI.

options.title: Defer Public Hooks And RPC
options.body: Keep any useful UI-only work but remove the new plugin/Gateway contract until maintainers approve the broader activity model.

options.title: Pause Behind The Canonical Issue
options.body: Leave this PR blocked or close it if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to settle the API before implementation branches continue.

recommendation.title: Align And Repair This PR
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the implementation vehicle only after it matches the canonical activity semantics, fixes selected-global scoping, and rebases onto the current UI.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the assignee on the canonical session activity contract issue and recently touched adjacent UI/plugin surfaces on current main.
